witness.branch: Intersection approach in a right-turn lane
witness.quote: Be driven in the right turn lane only for the purpose of making a right turn.
witness.reason: An intersection right turn can use the specified lane when its governance and connection are established.
required_context: Ego occupies the designated lane for its intended route.
Establish public-highway status, a single right lane designed only for turning, its extent and its connection to ego's route.
Preserve purpose as unresolved; a completed turn or particular heading change is not a conclusive statutory test.
Public-highway status and the single right lane's exclusive turning design.
Retain route-purpose evidence, lane occupancy and subsequent movement.
Supported approach, lane extent and right-turn departure geometry.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor-vehicle driver controls a conventional vehicle within statutory scope.
